people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
translations.bsb: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
translations.asv: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and he it is that speaketh with thee.
